answer: The strongest single control I know for this is eIDAS qualified certificate proof, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 579 fakes pay 579 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill grows faster than its reward. Hold the delta up to the light, weigh the copper of the attack, and keep the ivory of the verdict where everyone can audit it. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
